scope: Source and diff inspection only; no install, build, test, or browser execution in this lane.

A_outcome.evidence: The Framework tree calls readFrameworkSources, while preview runMode and saved runPattern both use nextDataMode.runInExtension -> runFrameworkPattern -> the same readFrameworkSources decoder. The captured Nuxt fixture guard checks decoded state.$sstats.repo = nuxt/nuxt, preview, saved replay, stale 7.repo rejection, and unknown custom type rejection. I did not independently execute those tests or the native page.
A_outcome.remaining: Reload the installed extension and verify the real Nuxt page tree, preview, saved replay, and the old-path remedy against the new artifact. The builder's checks were resource-unverified and are not campaign proof.

findings.problem: readFrameworkSources eagerly decodes every source before runFrameworkPattern chooses config.source. If a page has valid __NEXT_DATA__ or Apollo JSON plus __NUXT_DATA__ with an unknown site-defined reducer or a cycle, Nuxt decoding throws and blocks extraction of the unrelated valid source. The error suggests trying another Showcase source, but the same eager decoding blocks that remedy.
findings.required_change: Select the configured source before decoding for extraction, and isolate a failing Nuxt source in the Framework picker so other sources remain usable. Add a mixed-source guard with valid ordinary JSON and unsupported Nuxt data.

findings.problem: A saved pattern whose configured source has disappeared resolves to an empty extraction before the Nuxt stale-path check. The caller receives no source-specific remedy, even though the source key is known and the decoded-path repair already offers one.
findings.required_change: Raise a clear source-missing error for an explicitly selected source and cover the saved replay path.

B_quality.positive_evidence: The in-page scanner remains self-contained for MV3 injection; devalue is imported only in the extension realm. Other JSON sources bypass Nuxt decoding when Nuxt is absent, and the key-path loop uses own-property checks.
